status: Registered and pushed before any row at dev offsets 1200 to 1699 was read.
question: Does adding the local model's drafted prompt to the orientation brief help a Claude host, with tools and on the paste path?

candidate.control_brief: shake_bake brief --root <repo> --task <issue> (orientation layout, the default since 0.4.0.dev22)
candidate.draft_brief: the same command with --model qwen3.5:4b against the loopback Ollama on this PC

worker_model.name: qwen3.5:4b
worker_model.note: digest checked before and after rendering; one render per case; settings are the worker's fixed requested settings

cases.pool: dev rows at offsets 1200 to 1699 (never read), minus every text_id of the 50-row py test split (by id only), minus every repository used in any earlier run (external, frozen, host, paste, both orientation runs)
cases.filters: changed_files_count 2 to 6 and code_changed_files_count at least 2; permissive repository license (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2/3, ISC, MPL-2.0); 50 to 1,500 non-test files; one case per repository
cases.selection: first 8 by sha256('shake-bake-draft-2026-11-08-v1:' + text_id), each repository represented by its lowest-hash row, no replacements
cases.acquisition: shallow git fetch at base_sha, copied without .git; caps 300 MiB per checkout, 2 GiB total; omissions disclosed
cases.worker_failure: if the worker refuses or fails on a case, its draft brief equals the control brief; the case stays in and is disclosed

arms.orientation_tools: tools + control brief (prompt identical to the orientation runs' orientation_tools arm)
arms.orientation_paste: no tools, issue + control brief (prompt identical to the orientation runs' orientation_paste arm)
arms.draft_paste: no tools, issue + draft brief (same prompt)

host: Claude Code subagent, general-purpose type, sonnet alias, one run per case and arm
measure: hits at 5: files named in the final FILES line that the fixing pull request changed; also tool calls, tokens and seconds

decision_rules.tools_path: the draft helps only if total hits at 5 are higher than orientation_tools AND the draft arm wins more cases than it loses
decision_rules.paste_path: the draft helps only if total hits at 5 are higher than orientation_paste AND the draft arm wins more cases than it loses
decision_rules.harm: reported as harm on a path if total hits at 5 are lower AND the draft arm loses more cases than it wins
decision_rules.otherwise: no effect shown; Local AI stays optional and the brief makes no claim for the draft

limits: one local model at one setting
public issues may be in the host's training data
